title: Outbreak Line List: Missing Contact Assignments

fields.summary: Attempted to assign contact tracer for Case 26-04412 (child in Lindell) but found no contact list in the line list. The case shows a 'completed' status with no notes, lab result, or assignment. Paper line list (MCHD-F-12) confirms no contact assignments were made. Version history shows a modification at 10:18:47 by 'svc-iisexport@marstonhealth.example'. No user activity log entry for that account.

findings.notes: No assignment recorded in line list; paper version confirms no action taken.
Case marked 'completed' without evidence of investigation or lab confirmation.
No user activity log entry for svc-iisexport@marstonhealth.example.
Unauthorized edit detected; timestamped 10:18:47.
MCHD-F-12 shows no contact assignments; consistent with digital version.
No lab data present in digital or paper record.
Listed as 2026-10-24 to 2026-11-01 — invalid for current date (2026-10-22).
Corrupted export may have overwritten case data; file modified by svc-iisexport@marstonhealth.example.
Version change attributed to service account with no audit trail.
DOC kit available at Level 2; used to verify paper line list.

actionsTaken: Verified paper line list (MCHD-F-12) against printed master
Marked Case 26-04412 as 'unverified' on DOC status board
Reported anomaly to IT and Incident Commander via secure email
recommendations: Do not assign contact tracers until data integrity is confirmed
Audit all case updates in the line list against paper master and logs
Declare paper mode for Epi team if digital data remains untrustworthy
fields.photosNote: 1 photo attached: Screenshot of SharePoint version history showing edit by svc-iisexport@marstonhealth.example at 10:18:47

instructorNote: This inject confirms the data breach has altered case status and removed contact assignments. Epi must now verify all line list entries against paper and halt assignments. Watch for attempts to override paper mode.

citations.headingPath: Marston County Health Department… › Section 5 › 5.2 Outbreak numbers and line lists
citations.quote: The Lead Epidemiologist assigns an outbreak number (format OB-2026-0147) and opens the line list from template MCHD-F-12. The working line list lives on the county SharePoint site "MCHD Epi Response";

citations.documentTitle: Marston County Health Department — Cyber Incident Response Annex
citations.quote: Paper mode is declared by the Incident Commander (decision record CYB-DR-1). In paper mode: - Disease reports are taken by phone on MCHD-F-10; investigators work cases in the state surveillance system

citations.headingPath: Marston County Health Department… › Annex A
